t: These Saxby CosmosEco V3 fixed fire-rated LED recessed downlights offer efficient and safe illumination for both domestic and commercial installations. Each 6W unit provides 500 lumens of warm white light, creating an inviting atmosphere, ideal for kitchens, living rooms, and specifically bathrooms due to their Zone 1 IP65 rating. Installation is swift and simple, requiring a standard 57mm holesaw and featuring a 4-way, screwless push-fit terminal block for electricians. The integrated LED driver and dimmable functionality provide flexible lighting control, while the robust steel body ensures a long 50,000-hour lifespan.
